question: Neeraj Chopra Wins Gold at Paris Diamond League 2025. What was Neeraj Chopra's best throw?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**88.16 meters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra Wins Gold at Paris Diamond League 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Neeraj Chopra** won the **men’s javelin throw** at the **Paris Diamond League 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held at **Stade Sébastien Charléty**.

 
 
• 
 
Neeraj's **best throw**: **88.16 meters** (on his **first attempt**).

 
 
• 
 
**Julian Weber** of **Germany** came **second** with **87.88 meters**.

 
 
• 
 
**Luiz Maurício da Silva** of **Brazil** came **third** with **86.62 meters** (a **new South American record**).

 
 
• 
 
This is the **first time this season** Neeraj has beaten **Julian Weber**.

 
 
• 
 
At the **Doha Diamond League 2025**

 
 
• 
 
**Weber** threw a **personal best of 91.06 meters** (won the event).

 
 
• 
 
**Chopra** threw **90.23 meters**, **resetting the Indian national record**.
